name: Catalogue 3D Lot Cards and Interactive Product Detail 3D Stage

planSteps.description: Navigate to /catalogue and verify the curated lots catalogue loads
Verify the 3D Interactive badge is visible on the auction lot cards
Click on the Mughal Basra Pearl Sautoir lot card or link to open its detail page
Verify the Interactive 3D Stage tab is active and the 3D canvas is present
Verify the 3D action controls for Zoom In, Zoom Out, and Reset View are visible
